definition.tokens: prompt_tokens + completion_tokens per request row (all prompt tokens, cached and uncached). A row with a null prompt_tokens or completion_tokens is EXCLUDED from the sum and counted in tvs.excluded_null_token_rows; it is never treated as 0.
definition.cached_share: sum(cached_tokens)/sum(prompt_tokens) over rows whose cached_tokens is non-null; reported as a diagnostic only, never in place of the primary number.
definition.verified_success: a checkpoint cell whose verdict is `pass` under grade_v5 (the instrument of record). A cell with verdict `fail` or `undecidable` is not a success.
definition.window: every DISTINCT request from the run's first request through the checkpoint's own turn, inclusive; fetch/tool-follow-up requests at that turn are included because they bill. Duplicate records of one request (same arm/rep/turn/ts/prompt/completion/content_sha256) are counted once and reported as duplicate_records_skipped.
definition.first_success: the earliest passing checkpoint turn; later passes do not change the number.
definition.no_success: tvs is null with reason 'no_verified_success' -- never 0, never the whole-run total.
definition.pooling: never pooled across grids; a grid whose code changed mid-cell carries that fact beside the number.

instrument.rule: ANSWER-CONTRACT v1 (forced one-line answer, value graded against AST truth)

denominator.pairs_not_produced_why: no grade_v5 output exists; grade_v3/grade_v4 are not the instrument of record
denominator.repair_t30: dropped from TVS's declared space: grade_v5 emits no verdict for it, so it can neither certify a success nor sit in the denominator

code_state.detail: V6 ran turns 1-6 before a correction, then turns 7-48. The summed window for a checkpoint at turn >= 7 therefore spans two code states; the number is carried beside this fact, never as if the cell were homogeneous.

restamp_method.method: additive restamp: each record gained rows_file/rows_sha256/rows_size/computed_at/grader_sha256 computed from the rows file bytes on disk; tvs sub-blocks gained the same five fields. No existing key was edited or removed; the figures were re-derived first and compared (see reproductions).
restamp_method.rows_sha256: sha256 of the rows file's bytes at restamp time
restamp_method.grader_sha256: resolved through tools/grader_identity.py from each grade document; null where that document carries no stamp (all historical grade files) -- never a hardcoded pin
restamp_method.computed_at: restamp time for records whose original read time was never recorded (historical)

grader_pin_check.note: the pinned sha is a DECLARED historical claim; the grader file on disk no longer hashes to it, so no record claims it as its own grader identity
